value.body: Small, mathematics-heavy degrees at two specialised institutes. The Indian Statistical Institute offers a B.Stat (Hons) at Kolkata and a B.Math (Hons) at Bengaluru, each three years long. Chennai Mathematical Institute offers a four-year BS (Honours) in Mathematics, Mathematics and Computer Science, or Mathematics and Physics, with an exit option after three years.

items.label: Course length
items.note: ISI: 3 years. CMI: 4 years, with a B.Sc exit after 3 years

items.label: ISI seats per programme
items.note: Each of B.Stat and B.Math; extra seats for INMO qualifiers

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Class 12 with Mathematics. ISI admits through its own ISI Admission Test (held in May); INMO qualifiers can get extra seats. CMI admits through its own entrance exam (also in May), and strong performers in national olympiads may be exempted.

value.title: At a glance
items: Seats are few and the entrance tests are mathematics-heavy.
Graduates often continue to a master's or PhD, or move into data, finance and software roles.
ISI's BSDS (data science) programme has a separate admission route.
